name: Mousou Kyoushitsu
source:
Yamada is a grade schooler like any other.

One boring day after the other pass him by. One day after school, he's given a "lesson" by another child who claims to be a "teacher". A lesson about "death".

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090213172638/http://geminiworks.ame-zaiku.com/mousou.html]the Official website[/url]]
